page.overview:
What is Uncle Meat's Java Hole?

Uncle Meat's Java Hole was a vintage record store and coffee shop run by an aging hippie who called himself "Uncle Meat". Laurie Strode, Harley David and Mya Rockwell worked here for a brief period of time in 2009. Category:Locations
